name: Southern Natural Gas South System Expansion III Phase 1

values.SegmentName: South System Expansion III Project, Phase 1

researcher_notes: Not an existing row: roster has only the Southern Natural Gas system row (P0252) and the South System Expansion 4 project (P7855); no row for the 2010 expansion. Source is the EIA natural gas pipeline projects workbook, August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 675. It lists South System Expansion III Phase 1, Southern Natural Gas Co, expansion, completed, in service 10 December 2010, state GA, 41.1 miles, 36 inch, 125 MMcf/d added, interstate, FERC docket CP09-36. Passes the 15.5 mile new-pipe rule. Only one source found; web search was unavailable during this run, so no FERC order or operator release was checked. A FERC order for docket CP09-36 should be pulled to confirm length, loop location and the in-service date. Capacity is incremental. Owner name left as the source spells it; no exact entity hit in the gazetteer (closest is Southern Natural Gas). Phases 2 (19.7 mi, MS) and 3 (19.3 mi, MS/AL/GA) of the same docket are are each above the 15.5 mile threshold and also have no row; they should be vetted as separate candidates. No route researched; route type unavailable pending the FERC filing.
